kpi.revenueHint: Sum of order baseCost, USD — not accounting revenue
kpi.n2Hint: % of mature orders (in production ≥ 2 days) shipped within 2 days
kpi.backlogHint: Orders not packed yet, right now

flow.title: Production flow
flow.hint: Each order sits in exactly one stage — click a tile to open those orders

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.hint: Cross-cutting flags — one order may carry several

types.title: Top product types
types.hint: Top {{n}} by orders, bar split by stage

findings.title: Key findings
findings.noActions: Nothing urgent — keep the current pace.
findings.sla_n2_below: Only {{pct}}% of mature orders shipped within 2 days (target {{target}}%), {{gap}} points short — lowest {{factory}} at {{factoryPct}}%.
findings.sla_n2_ok: {{pct}}% of orders shipped within 2 days — on target.
findings.overdue_orders: {{n}} overdue orders (3+ days) still open, most at {{factory}} ({{factoryN}}); oldest {{oldest}} days.
findings.in_exceeds_out: {{in}} orders in but only {{out}} out — backlog grew by {{gap}} this period.
findings.backlog_rising: Backlog in the factory is {{backlog}} orders, up {{pct}}% since period start ({{prev}}).
findings.factory_slow_clear: At current pace these factories need over 3 days to clear backlog: {{factory}}.
findings.error_rate_high: Error rate {{pct}}% ({{delta}} pts vs previous); main source {{source}} {{share}}%; most affected type: {{type}}.
findings.error_rate_down: Error rate {{pct}}%, down {{delta}} points vs previous period.
findings.customer_concentration: Top 10 customers make {{pct}}% of orders — high concentration.
findings.revenue_up: Order value {{total}} USD, up {{pct}}% vs previous ({{prev}}).
findings.revenue_down: Order value {{total}} USD, down {{pct}}% vs previous ({{prev}}).
findings.weekend_day: {{day}} is a {{weekday}} — low in/out volume follows the weekly rhythm, not a drop.
findings.sla_pending: No mature cohort yet to evaluate on-time (orders from {{cohort}} are under 2 days old).
findings.output_down_day: Shipped {{out}}, below yesterday ({{prev}}) and {{pctAvg}}% below the 7-day average ({{avg7}}) — not weekly rhythm.
findings.output_up_day: Shipped {{out}}, above yesterday ({{prev}}) and {{pctAvg}}% above the 7-day average ({{avg7}}).

actions.act_unblock_stage: Meet the {{factory}} shift lead today to unblock the stuck stage
actions.act_clear_overdue: Review the 5 oldest overdue orders and commit a ship date for each
actions.act_check_capacity: Check capacity: overtime or move orders between factories
actions.act_rebalance_factory: Move orders away from the slow-clearing factory
actions.act_review_design: Review the design file check process with the designer lead
actions.act_review_factory: Review stage errors with the factory against the error catalog
actions.act_contact_customers: Sales to contact declining customers this week
actions.act_vip_followup: Prioritize held/errored orders of VIP customers
actions.act_rebalance_design: Rebalance design work away from overloaded designers
